page_title: LIV 0-3 NOT | Liverpool v Nottingham Forest 22/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
90+4' The ball possession is 74:26.
90+1' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
90+1' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' Alisson comes off his line to intercept the corner from Elliot Anderson (Nottingham).
87' Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
86' Substitution. Dan Ndoye makes way for Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham).
86' Sean Dyche prepares a substitution. Igor Jesus is replaced by Ryan Yates (Nottingham).
84' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) gets on the end of a nice cross, but places his close-range header well wide of the left post.
84' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.

82' Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
82' That's unlucky! Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
78' 0 - 3 Goal! Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:3.
78' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) zig-zags his way into the box and fails to direct a shot inside the left post. The goalkeeper pulls off a miraculous stop.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) will replace Curtis Jones.

78' A nice pass finds Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) in space. He sets himself up and hammers in a fantastic low shot from distance that looks bound for the middle of the goal, but the out of position Matz Sels pulls off a breathtaking save to deny him.
76' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
76' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
74' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
72' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) attempts to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but his effort fails to reach the goal.
71' Poor challenge! Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) is penalised for tripping and Andy Madley blows his whistle. Nottingham earn a free kick.
68' Arne Slot has decided to make a change. Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) replaces Milos Kerkez.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alexander Isak trots off the pitch and is replaced by Federico Chiesa (Liverpool).
68' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
66' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
66' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but Matz Sels comes off his line to gather the ball.

64' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Alisson was alert and the score remained the same.
63' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
61' A substitution has been made. Nicolas Dominguez goes off and Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) comes on.
60' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
59' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
57' The foul by Alexander Isak (Liverpool) was seen by Andy Madley who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
55' Ibrahima Konate comes off the pitch to be replaced by Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool).
53' Corner kick. Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) is ready to send the ball into the box.
52' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Nottingham will have a corner.
49' Great teamplay by Liverpool as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
46' 0 - 2 Goal! Neco Williams plays a pass to the feet of Nicolo Savona (Nottingham), and he shoots into the back of the net from inside the box. It's 0:2.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+3' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) steps up to take the free kick, but his crossfield pass fails to reach any of his teammates.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

45' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) zig-zags his way into the box and fires the ball towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort. The linesman points to the corner flag, Liverpool are going to take it.

42' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the top left corner, but Matz Sels keeps the ball out.
41' Andy Madley couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) and blew his whistle. Liverpool are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
40' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) whips in the free kick, but one of the defenders comfortably clears the ball away.
39' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
37' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Nottingham due to a handball in the build-up play.
36' That looked like a handball in the build-up play and the referee Andy Madley is going to take a look using VAR.
35' Goal, no wait. Andy Madley blows his whistle for handball and Igor Jesus (Nottingham) can't celebrate. Disallowed goal.
34' Referee Andy Madley points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Murillo (Nottingham) goes wild in celebration.
33' Wait! Referee Andy Madley has indicated he is going to review the Nottingham goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
33' 0 - 1 Goal! Murillo (Nottingham) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 0:1.
33' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) will deliver the corner kick.
31' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Cody Gakpo (Liverpool). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
31' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

30' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Liverpool will take a corner.
30' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
28' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) commits a rough challenge and Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul.
27' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Liverpool.

25' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
25' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
25' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
24' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
22' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
21' PENALTY APPEAL after Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
20' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
16' Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
15' The Liverpool players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break. 75:25 – the latest ball possession ratio.
12' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
11' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) takes the corner but it's cleared.

10' What a great touch by Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot towards the roof of the net, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
8' Neat passing move from Liverpool in order to create new attacking opportunities.
6' The corner from Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is hurriedly cleared.

4' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
3' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Liverpool will have the kick-off.
Andy Madley is the one to supervise the game today.
